 Singapore Airlines to Upgrade KrisWorld Entertainment and Starlink Wi-Fi in 2027
 By IE Author - October 26, 2026 
 Source: ChatGPT 
 Singapore Airlines plans to upgrade its KrisWorld entertainment system and add faster Wi-Fi to some of its planes. The airline will start offering Starlink Wi-Fi in early 2027. Passengers can look forward to better screens, more movies and shows, and faster internet. The airline will add these features to selected planes over time. 
 What Is New in Singapore Airlines KrisWorld Entertainment System? 
 KrisWorld is the entertainment system that passengers use on Singapore Airlines flights. It lets them watch movies, listen to music, and enjoy TV shows. The airline plans to add several new features to the system. Here is what passengers can expect: 
 New 4K screens will make movies and TV shows look clearer. Some planes will also have OLED screens. 
 The new sound system will improve the audio quality of movies and music. 
 Passengers can connect their own Bluetooth headphones on seats that support this feature. 
 Some cabin classes will have headphones that help block out noise. 
 KrisWorld will offer more than 2,500 entertainment choices, including movies, shows, and music. 
 These changes will give passengers more options to enjoy during their flights. 
 Singapore Airlines to Introduce Starlink High-Speed Wi-Fi in 2027 
 Singapore Airlines also plans to bring Starlink Wi-Fi to selected planes in early 2027. The airline will add the service to Airbus A380, A350-900 long-haul, and A350-900 ultra-long-range aircraft in stages. Starlink provides internet through satellites. With this service, passengers can send messages, watch videos, check social media, and work online while flying. 
 Singapore Airlines will continue to offer free unlimited Wi-Fi to eligible passengers. Those flying in Suites, First Class, and Business Class will get free access. PPS Club members and KrisFlyer members travelling in Premium Economy and Economy Class will also qualify. The new Wi-Fi service will help passengers stay in touch with family and friends or use the internet during long flights. 
 KrisWorld Upgrade Benefits to Passengers 
 The new KrisWorld system will give passengers more things to enjoy during their flight. They can watch movies on clearer screens, listen to music with better sound, or use their own Bluetooth headphones where available. The improved entertainment system will also make it easier to find something to watch. Along with faster Wi-Fi, passengers will have more ways to relax, stay connected, or spend their time during long journeys. 
 Singapore Airlines to Reveal More Travel Upgrades in November 2026 
 The KrisWorld upgrade is part of Singapore Airlines’ wider plan to improve its passenger services. Along with the new entertainment system and faster Wi-Fi, the airline is working on updated long-haul cabins, refreshed meals, new onboard amenities, and improved airport services. Singapore Airlines plans to reveal more details about these changes in November 2026. The airline will introduce the new services in stages, so passengers may experience different features depending on their aircraft and travel date. 
 Singapore Airlines is preparing to improve its inflight experience with a new KrisWorld entertainment system and Starlink high-speed Wi-Fi. From 4K screens and Bluetooth audio to more entertainment choices and faster internet, the upcoming changes will give passengers more options during their journeys.
